name: redforttech-platform
description: RedFort Tech — combined platform: public website, CMS admin panel, and NestJS backend API.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix redfortBackend && npm install --prefix redfortwebsit && npm install --prefix cms
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:content
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:cms
scripts.lint: npm run --prefix redfortwebsit lint && npm run --prefix cms lint
